film.short_synopsis_html: The Joad family is forced off their drought-ridden farm in Oklahoma after it is seized by a bank. When Tom Joad is released from prison they decide to travel to California in search of a better life, but suffer the misfortunes and hardships of the homeless in the Great Depression.
film.title: The Grapes of Wrath
